chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Ibn Abi Nasr from Asim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:

I asked him, 'When does one join the prayer with the Imam?' He said, 'When one catches the Imam while he is in the final prostration of his prayer, then one has joined the virtue of the prayer with the Imam.'

key_terms.لِفَضْلِ الصَّلَاةِ: for the virtue/reward of the prayer
key_terms.يُدْرِكُ: to catch/join (in the context of prayer)

ai.seo_question: When is a person considered to have joined the congregational prayer with the Imam?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the jurisprudential threshold for 'joining' the Imam, distinguishing between merely catching the prayer and attaining the specific spiritual merit of congregational worship. By defining the final prostration as the cutoff point, it provides practical guidance for worshippers to maximize their reward even when arriving late, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the communal unity and spiritual benefits of following the Imam.
